### Foundational Framework Papers

- **AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation**  
  *Authors:* Qingyun Wu et al.  
  *Links:* [arXiv:2308.08155](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.08155)  
  *Focus:* Conversational orchestration framework utilizing customizable, conversable agents that integrate LLMs, human input, and tool usage. Citations: 5,514+.

- **MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework**  
  *Authors:* Sirui Hong et al.  
  *Links:* [arXiv:2308.00352](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.00352) | [ICLR 2024](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/6507b115562bb0a305f1958ccc87355a-Abstract-Conference.html)  
  *Focus:* SOP-driven multi-agent orchestration structure using standardized outputs and role assignment (Architect, Engineer, Product Manager). Citations: 4,338+.

- **ChatDev: Communicative Agents for Software Development**  
  *Authors:* Chen Qian et al.  
  *Links:* [arXiv:2307.07924](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07924) | [ACL 2024](https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.810/)  
  *Focus:* Multi-agent communication pipeline structured around the Waterfall model (design, coding, testing, documentation). Citations: 2,617+.

---

### Survey and Architecture Review Papers

- **Large Language Model Based Multi-Agents: A Survey of Progress and Challenges**  
  *Authors:* Taicheng Guo et al.  
  *Links:* [arXiv:2402.01680](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.01680)  
  *Focus:* Broad survey covering coordination paradigms, communication structures, consensus mechanisms, and benchmarks. Citations: 2,532.

- **A Survey on LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems: Workflow, Infrastructure, and Challenges**  
  *Authors:* X. Li et al.  
  *Links:* [Springer Vicinagearth](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s44336-024-00009-2)  
  *Focus:* Infrastructure pipelines, multi-agent workflow composition, interaction protocols, and system bottlenecks. Citations: 998.

- **Multi-Agent Collaboration Mechanisms: A Survey of LLMs**  
  *Authors:* K. T. Tran et al.  
  *Links:* [arXiv:2501.06322](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06322)  
  *Focus:* Centralized vs. decentralized orchestration, collaborative problem-solving, and emergent multi-agent behaviors. Citations: 820.

- **Beyond Self-Talk: A Communication-Centric Survey of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems**  
  *Authors:* B. Yan et al.  
  *Links:* [arXiv:2502.14321](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14321)  
  *Focus:* Communication routing, network topologies, message-passing formats, and coordination efficiency. Citations: 150.

- **Multi-Agent Coordination Across Diverse Applications: A Survey**  
  *Authors:* L. Sun et al.  
  *Links:* [arXiv:2502.14743](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14743)  
  *Focus:* Hierarchical and decentralized coordination architectures, human-in-the-loop coordination, and application deployments. Citations: 98.

---

### Findings Comparison
The findings split into two complementary tracks: foundational system architectures (AutoGen, MetaGPT, ChatDev) and taxonomy/survey papers. No conflicting data points were identified across the searches.

  - **Citations:** 820

  - **PDF Link:** [arXiv:2501.06322](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.06322)

  - **Authors:** B. Yan, Z. Zhou, L. Zhang, Z. Zhou, et al.
  - **Citations:** 150
  - **Focus:** Analysis of agent coordination from an inter-agent communication perspective, examining message passing topologies, routing mechanisms, and coordination efficiency.
  - **PDF Link:** [arXiv:2502.14321](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2502.14321)

- **[Multi-Agent Coordination Across Diverse Applications: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14743)**
  - **Authors:** L. Sun, Y. Yang, Q. Duan, Y. Shi, C. Lyu, et al.
  - **Citations:** 98
  - **Focus:** Taxonomy comparing hierarchical and decentralized coordination architectures, human-in-the-loop multi-agent orchestration, and real-world deployment challenges.
  - **PDF Link:** [arXiv:2502.14743](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2502.14743)

#### 1. AutoGen
- **Title:** AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation
- **Authors:** Qingyun Wu, Gagan Bansal, Jieyu Zhang, Yiran Wu, Beibin Li, Erkang Zhu, Li Jiang, Xiaoyun Zhang, Shaokun Zhang, Jiale Liu, Ahmed Hassan Awadallah, Ryen W White, Doug Burger, Chi Wang
- **arXiv ID:** [arXiv:2308.08155](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.08155)
- **Publication Date:** August 16, 2023 (v1)

- **Core Contribution:** Generic open-source multi-agent orchestration framework where customizable, conversable agents leverage combinations of LLMs, human inputs, and tools via flexible conversational patterns.

- **Authors:** Sirui Hong, Mingchen Zhuge, Jiaqi Chen, Xiawu Zheng, Yuheng Cheng, Ceyao Zhang, Jinlin Wang, Zili Wang, Steven Ka Shing Yau, Zijuan Lin, Liyang Zhou, Chenyu Ran, Lingfeng Xiao, Chenglin Wu, Jürgen Schmidhuber
- **arXiv ID:** [arXiv:2308.00352](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.00352) | [ICLR 2024](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/hash/6507b115562bb0a305f1958ccc87355a-Abstract-Conference.html)

- **Google Scholar Citations:** 4,338+ citations
- **Core Contribution:** Meta-programming multi-agent framework incorporating Standardized Operating Procedures (SOPs) and structured communication interfaces to coordinate software development roles (Product Manager, Architect, Project Manager, Engineer).

#### 3. ChatDev
- **Title:** ChatDev: Communicative Agents for Software Development
- **Authors:** Chen Qian, Wei Liu, Hongzhang Liu, Nuo Chen, Yufan Dang, Jiahao Li, Cheng Yang, Weize Chen, Yusheng Su, Xin Cong, Juyuan Xu, Dahai Li, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun

- **Publication Date:** July 15, 2023 (v1), accepted at ACL 2024
- **Google Scholar Citations:** 2,617+ citations
- **Core Contribution:** Virtual software development company architecture based on the Waterfall model, utilizing multi-turn communicative dialogue phases (designing, coding, testing, documenting) to solve software engineering tasks.
